name: Ech xao sa ot
summary: Ếch xào sả ớt is frog stir-fried with lemongrass and chili, a seafood-pub plate on Da Nang’s Phan Tứ, beside grilled stingray and a seafood hotpot.
howToEat: Order it on Phan Tứ in the evening.
where: Phan Tứ, Ngũ Hành Sơn, in the evening, from about 17:00 to midnight.
seoTitle: Ech xao sa ot — lemongrass chili frog on Phan Tu
seoDescription: Ếch xào sả ớt is frog stir-fried with lemongrass and chili on Phan Tứ in Da Nang, an evening street.
